_why: Committed numbers the live-site check compares against. Never yesterday's output: a self-comparison drifts every day and the tolerance ends up fitted to its own noise. Live sitemap held 9,354 URLs on 2026-09-24; the floor is ~85% of that so growth passes and a collapsed deploy (deploy.sh once nearly shipped 17 files) fails. Raise it deliberately when the catalogue grows, in a commit that says why.
_allowed_external_why: Both measured in a browser on 2026-09-24 and both chosen: Simple Analytics (Arun asked for it, 2026-09-20) and the Cloudflare Pages beacon (auto-injected at runtime, so it is permitted, not required). Any third host fails. The property that survives is 'no third-party PLAYER bytes before a click', not 'no third party'.
